name: Bwindi
tagline: Mountain gorillas in the Impenetrable Forest
summary: Bwindi Impenetrable Forest in southwest Uganda is home to nearly half the world's mountain gorillas. Trek with rangers through steep rainforest for an unforgettable hour with a habituated gorilla family, visit Batwa communities, and relax at Lake Bunyonyi's terraced islands.
seasonNote: June to August and December to February are drier; trekking runs all year.
arrival: Fly from Entebbe to Kihihi or Kisoro, or drive 8 to 10 hours from Kampala.
gettingAround: 4x4 with a driver; lodges arrange transfers.
cashTip: Ugandan shillings for small purchases; park fees and permits are in US dollars. Tip guides and porters.
foodTip: Lodge meals, rolex (chapati egg roll) and Ugandan coffee.
baseArea: Buhoma, Ruhija, Rushaga or Nkuringo sectors

connections.note: Domestic flights from Entebbe; or a long drive.
